name: PDFForge Studio v1.2.4 (Native Rust Edition)
notes: PDFForge Studio v1.2.4: Major large-PDF & multi-tab architecture upgrade — memmap2 HTTP Range 206 streaming, page virtualization & 16 MP/tile zoom cap, global LRU bitmap & thumb caches, 2-worker pool, auto tab suspension, chunked search with cancel, Rust pdfium heavy rendering & background combine/split/extract/compress jobs, and memory settings.
